newsletter._note: Fill these in after creating the Buttondown account. Until buttondownUsername and postalAddress are both set, the signup forms stay off the page. postalAddress goes in every email (CAN-SPAM); a PO box is fine. sendMode 'draft' leaves each weekly email in Buttondown for you to review and send; 'send' sends it automatically.

contact._note: Let's Connect form in the footer. Create a free Web3Forms access key at https://web3forms.com using rob@workathill.com (messages go to the email the key was made with), then paste it here. The key is meant to be public: it can only send messages to that inbox. Until it's set, the form stays off the page.
